description.short_caption: Multiple erythematous papules and vesicles on the forehead.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the forehead of a patient with numerous erythematous papules and vesicles distributed across the skin. The lesions vary in size and are dome-shaped, some appearing to have a central umbilication. The surrounding skin shows mild erythema. The lesions are consistent with a vesiculopapular eruption, potentially infectious in origin.
